d.ko: Bring kindness and light to the people of Sainte-et-Claire as Lila—a tiny mouse with a big heart! Explore a quaint French village, make electrifying new friends, and do good deeds for those in need in this lush narrative adventure game.
d.en: Bring kindness and light to the people of Sainte-et-Claire as Lila—a tiny mouse with a big heart! Explore a quaint French village, make electrifying new friends, and do good deeds for those in need in this lush narrative adventure game.
d.zh: 扮演拥有宽广心胸的小老鼠 Lila，将友善与光明带给 Sainte-et-Claire 的人们！在这段赏心悦目的叙事冒险中，探索古老风情的法国村镇，结交惊人的朋友，做好事帮助需要帮助的人！
